_disclaimer: Seed values pulled from IBC 2018, NFPA 101, FBC, CBC, and Chicago Construction Code references. Every rule is marked verify=true — DO NOT treat any number here as authoritative. Use it as a planning aid; the AHJ governs.

aisleMinWidth.label: Min aisle width
aisleMinWidth.description: Minimum clear width of an aisle in a place of public assembly. The strictest active jurisdiction wins.

aisleCapacityFactor.label: Aisle width per occupant
aisleCapacityFactor.description: Aisle width must also be at least (occupants served × this factor). Validated as max(aisleMinWidth, occupants × factor).

theaterRowClearMin.label: Min clear between rows
theaterRowClearMin.description: Clear space between back of one row and front of the next (row pitch − chair depth).

maxSeatsRowOneAisle.label: Max seats per row, aisle at one end
maxSeatsRowOneAisle.description: Rows that egress to an aisle at only one end.

maxSeatsRowTwoAisles.label: Max seats per row, aisle at both ends
maxSeatsRowTwoAisles.description: Rows that egress to aisles at both ends.

roundsBackToBackMin.label: Min back-to-back chair spacing (rounds)
roundsBackToBackMin.description: Minimum distance between the back of a chair at one round and the back of the chair at the adjacent round.

stageClearanceMin.label: Min clearance front row to stage
stageClearanceMin.description: Clearance between the leading edge of the stage and the nearest chair / table.

cook.name: Cook County / City of Chicago
cook.basis: Chicago Construction Code (CCC) Title 14B, based on IBC 2018 with amendments

aisleMinWidth.note: Chicago amendment for assembly aisles. IBC baseline is 48" for >50 occupants.

maxSeatsRowTwoAisles.note: Both-end aisle access; smart-aisle rules can exceed this if egress sized accordingly.

roundsBackToBackMin.note: Industry-standard 5′ minimum; 6′ preferred for high-density events.

clark.name: Clark County, NV (Las Vegas)
clark.basis: Clark County Building Code, IBC 2018 with NFPA 101 referenced

buenaVista.name: Buena Vista, FL (Disney FL / Reedy Creek)
buenaVista.basis: Florida Building Code 8th ed (2023), former Reedy Creek Improvement District

reidyCreek.name: Reidy Creek, CA (Disney CA / Anaheim)
reidyCreek.basis: California Building Code 2022 (Title 24 Part 2), Anaheim AHJ

aisleMinWidth.note: CBC tracks IBC but is often more stringent for assembly.

roundsBackToBackMin.note: CA event spaces commonly enforce 6′ round-to-round.
